detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I'm Sanjay. I've been travelling since I moved from Pakistan to Stockholm in 2008; I live in Sydney now. My trips were scattered across a spreadsheet, airline apps, old inboxes and a photo library, so I built Trvlrr to hold all of it. It's how I plan all my future trips and look back at all my past ones. Forward a booking email (flights, trains, hotels, tours) to a private address and it lands on the right day of the right trip. Every past trip is kept, with stats that count only what actually happened. Photos are filed by trip and searchable by what's in them. It's in Claude's and ChatGPT's and Raycast directories, so you can install it and use it via MCP: ask "when was I last in Lisbon?" or "add this hotel to my Japan trip". In fact, this is how I imported all of my travel history. It's been a fun challenge working out the intricate details and adding features I'd always wanted in an app like this. iPhone app plus a full web app (Android is under development). Free covers everything for few trips, you can add more via mcp to onboard but the app should be functional. No ads, no data selling. Try without signing up: https://trvlrr.app/tools/countries-visited-map I'd love for you to try it and send me any feedback you have. Cheers, Sanjay
